strings.settings.language.help: App UI language. Changes apply immediately.

strings.settings.reduce_transparency.help: Uses opaque compact navigation and headers instead of backdrop blur.
strings.settings.network.help_network_hint: When on, this desktop can listen for peers (Node). Takes effect after unlock or app restart.
strings.settings.network.connection.title: Connection
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_un: Reachability has not been measured yet.
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_ch: Testing whether peers can connect to you…
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_re: Others can connect to this device directly.
Reachable via IPv6 — others can connect directly.
Router port mapping succeeded — testing inbound…
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_ou: You can reach the network, but inbound connections may need relay.
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_bl: Could not reach the network seed — check firewall or network.
strings.settings.network.help.outbound_only: Likely behind a home router: forward the WAN port shown under Listen address to this PC, then test again. CGNAT or ISP blocks may still prevent inbound.
strings.settings.network.help.blocked: Allow pp-browser in your OS firewall or try another network. VPNs can block peer connections.
strings.settings.network.help.reachable: Direct connections to you should work. Thank you for helping the network.
strings.settings.network.help.skip_relay: You can skip port forwarding — messaging still works via relay.
strings.settings.network.banner_hint: Direct connections may use relay until inbound works. See Me → Network.
strings.settings.network.circuit_relay_hint: Help NAT'd peers connect through this Node (volunteer).
strings.settings.network.media_relay_hint: Forward call media for friends and the network (blind; volunteer; default on).
strings.settings.network.prefer_contacts_hint: Ask and serve contacts before the org seed. Does not coerce friends.
strings.settings.security.default_hint: Your keys use the app default. Change it below for stronger protection.
strings.settings.security.not_setup_hint: Key protection is created when you first use secure messaging or register on the network.
strings.settings.security.group_invites.help: Controls who can invite you to group chats. Separate from direct messages.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered.help: Removes old undelivered delivery-queue items from the relay. Does not clear local chat history.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered_conf: This deletes undelivered relay inbox items older than 7 days. Local chat history on this device is not deleted.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered.not_: Unlock and register before clearing the delivery queue.
strings.settings.storage.reset_confirm_message: This permanently deletes local data for this profile (contacts, chats, keys). You cannot undo this.
strings.settings.storage.reset_confirm_check: I understand this cannot be undone
strings.settings.reset_defaults_confirm_message: This restores this section's settings to their defaults.
strings.pin.unlock_message: Enter your PIN to unlock secure data.
strings.pin.create_message: Choose a PIN to protect your keys and identity on this device.
strings.pin.chooser_message: Set a PIN, or continue with the app default for now.
strings.contacts.title: Contacts
strings.people_picker.title: New conversation
strings.people_picker.empty: No messageable contacts yet. Add contacts first.
strings.people_picker.empty_group_call: No other members in this group yet.
strings.chat.empty_body: Ask anything, or open Sessions to continue a thread.
strings.chat.delete_confirm: Delete this conversation? Message history will be removed.
strings.chat.group.leave_confirm: Leave this group? You’ll stop receiving messages, and your copy of the chat will be removed from this device.
strings.chat.group.leave_owner_confirm: Leave this group? Choose who becomes the new owner. Your copy of the chat will be removed from this device.
strings.chat.group.dismiss_confirm: Dismiss this group on this device? If nobody else is reachable, nothing is sent to peers.
strings.call.ring.callback_hint: {caller} is calling you back. Answering ends your outgoing call.
strings.call.ring.conflict_hint: Answering will end your current call with {peer}.
strings.call.notify.title: Incoming call
strings.call.error.wrong_thread_type: Voice and video calls are available in direct and group chats
strings.call.error.select_person: Select at least one person to call
strings.hints.network.local_macos: On Mac, allow Local Network for {product} in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
strings.hints.network.local_ios: Allow microphone and local network access for {product} in Settings.
strings.hints.network.firewall_windows: Check Windows microphone privacy and that the firewall allows {product}.
strings.hints.network.lan_linux: Check both devices are on the same network and UDP is not blocked.
strings.hints.mic_blocked: Microphone access looks blocked — enable it in system privacy settings.

strings.errors.auth.busy: Service is busy — try again shortly.

strings.errors.network.unreachable: Can't reach the server — check network or Me → Network / Assistant.
strings.errors.network.http: Request failed — try again, or check Me → Assistant.
strings.errors.pin.unlock: Unlock your profile PIN to continue.
strings.errors.config.missing_key: Configure the assistant in Me → Assistant.
strings.errors.config.invalid: Check settings in Me and try again.
strings.errors.storage.failed: Couldn't update local data — try again.
